AboutPage.introText1: Yiwu Yichi Health is a professional global supplier of medical consumables and devices, integrating international trade, supply chain integration and customized services. We provide one-stop medical solutions for global hospitals, clinics, nursing institutions and distributors, covering disposable medical supplies, household medical devices, clinical diagnostic equipment and basic medical instruments.
AboutPage.introText2: Our core products include syringes, infusion sets, medical gloves, blood glucose meters, oximeters, IVD rapid test kits and more. All cooperative production bases comply with the ISO 13485 system, and core products have CE and FDA certifications, meeting international quality and compliance standards.
AboutPage.introText3: Endowed with rich industry resources and mature trade experience, we have a stable global supply chain and strong OEM/ODM capabilities, providing personalized customization from material selection and design to packaging and labeling.
AboutPage.introText4: Adhering to the tenet of "Sincerity-Based, Quality First", we are committed to offering high-quality, cost-effective medical products and building long-term win-win partnerships with global customers. With professional trade services and in-depth market regulation knowledge, we fully support your medical supply business. Welcome to contact us for customized cooperation and product consultation!

AboutPage.contactDesc1: We do not have our prices displayed on this web site. Prices vary greatly with quantity required and destination. Before you order we need to compute shipping costs and then give you a quotation. You can ask for a quotation simply by emailing me your name, address, tools stock numbers and quantities required. After we have given you a quotation and you confirm it, we can proceed with the order. Email me if there is something more you want to know!
